# Perch

> Perch is a free, open-source (MIT) menu-bar app for macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. It combines four power-user tools in one native app: clipboard history, expanding text snippets, mouse button remapping (with a second "Mouse Shift" layer), and keyboard remapping with a Caps Lock Hyper Key. Mouse and keyboard behavior can be different in every app. No account, no tracking, no subscription; everything stays on the Mac.

## Features

- [Clipboard](https://perch.kodeelite.com/#clipboard): history of text, images and files opened with Shift+Cmd+V as a floating, keyboard-driven popup that keeps the current app focused; search as you type, categories (all/text/images/snippets), pins, Cmd+1-9 quick paste, edit before paste (Cmd+E), paste as plain text, screenshots captured automatically, restore-after-paste, auto-clear, per-app exclusions; passwords and sensitive copies are never recorded.
- [Snippets](https://perch.kodeelite.com/#snippets): type a trigger like ;meet; anywhere and it is replaced with saved text; placeholders {date}, {time}, {clipboard} and {cursor}; triggers can use ; : or // prefixes; per-app exclusions.
- [Mouse](https://perch.kodeelite.com/#mouse): scan to detect every button; click, double-click and hold actions per button; hold-and-flick gestures in four directions; per-app profiles; debounce for worn switches; scroll options (reverse, smooth, speed, no acceleration, turbo, Windows-style auto-scroll); pointer acceleration override; left-handed swap.
- [Mouse Shift](https://perch.kodeelite.com/#shift): hold a chosen button, then press another, to run a second action (like Logitech G-Shift). Each hold button has its own unlimited combos with click, double-click and hold slots.
- [Keys](https://perch.kodeelite.com/#keys): remap any key or shortcut per app, or map it to open an app; smart detect remaps only dedicated hardware shortcut keys; Caps Lock as a Hyper Key (Cmd+Opt+Ctrl+Shift) with its own tap and double-tap actions; double-tap a modifier to run an action.
- Actions: one shared catalogue for buttons, combos and shortcuts: editing, navigation, window snapping, Mission Control, screenshots, media, open any app/file/URL, custom keystrokes, shell scripts, AppleScript and Apple Shortcuts.
- Backup: export all settings to one JSON file; import by dropping it on Perch and choosing which sections to bring in.

## Install

- Download: https://perch.kodeelite.com/download (always the latest Perch.dmg)
- Terminal: curl -fsSL perch.kodeelite.com/install.sh | sh (verifies the checksum, installs to /Applications, clears the Gatekeeper warning)
- Homebrew: brew install --cask azharbinanwar/tap/perch
- Requirements: macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple Silicon. Perch asks for Accessibility (to control input) and Input Monitoring (to see devices and watch keys).
- Perch is not notarized; for DMG or Homebrew installs, approve the first launch once in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
- Updates: the app checks GitHub releases daily, verifies the checksum and opens the new DMG; Homebrew users run brew upgrade --cask perch.

## Project

- Source code: https://github.com/azharbinanwar/Perch (Swift, SwiftUI; MIT license)
- Releases and changelog: https://github.com/azharbinanwar/Perch/releases
- Report a bug: https://github.com/azharbinanwar/Perch/issues
- Privacy: https://perch.kodeelite.com/privacy.html (collects no personal data)
- Full reference for AI assistants: https://perch.kodeelite.com/llms-full.txt

## Comparable to

Perch covers the roles of a clipboard manager (like Maccy or Paste), a text expander (like aText or espanso), a mouse remapper (like LinearMouse, Mac Mouse Fix or BetterTouchTool) and a keyboard remapper (like Karabiner-Elements) in one free app.

Made by Kode Elite.
